scientific_integrity: Exact unrestricted proof by finite characters and subspace inversion; two finite exhaustive implementations checked n<=8 and n<=7. Finite checks not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Binary linear subspaces; diameter at most n-2; labeled coordinates. No arbitrary codiameter, nonlinear sets, permutation quotient, or exact-diameter count. The r=2 optimal-dimension specialization is known in stronger structural form. Fixed-r only for asymptotic ratio. Priority subject to independent literature audit.
title: Exact dimension-resolved counts of binary linear anticodes of codiameter two
